movelist.name: Worry Seed
movelist.effect: You choose one of the target’s Abilities. Worry Seed changes that Ability to Insomnia for the remainder of the encounter.

movelist.name: Petal Dance
movelist.effect: After damage is dealt, the user becomes Enraged and Confused.

movelist.name: Sunny Day
movelist.effect: The weather becomes Sunny for 5 rounds. While Sunny, Fire-Type Attacks gain a +5 bonus to Damage Rolls, and Water-Type Attacks suffer a -5 Damage penalty.

movelist.name: Helping Hand
movelist.effect: Helping Hand grants the target +2 on their next Accuracy Roll this round, and +10 to the next Damage Roll this round.

movelist.name: Leech Seed
movelist.effect: At the beginning of each of the target’s turns, Leech Seed’s target loses a Tick of Hit Points. Leech Seed’s user then gains Hit Points equal to the amount the target lost. Leech Seed lasts until the target faints or is returned to a Poké Ball. Grass Types and targets immune to Grass Attacks are immune to Leech Seed.

abilities.name: Flower Gift
abilities.effect: Flower Gift may only be used if the Weather is Sunny or if the user is under 50% Hit Points. When activated, the user may pick two Stats, gaining +2 Combat Stages in each Stat. All targets within 2 meters also gain +1 Combat Stage in each of the chosen Stats.

abilities.name: Sun Blanket
abilities.effect: The user gains a Tick of Hit Points. Sun Blanket may only be triggered while the user is under 50% Hit Points or in Sunny Weather.
